claims: Michael B. Jordan won Best Actor at the 98th Academy Awards (2026) for his role in Sinners.
Michael B. Jordan was nominated for Best Actor (Leading Role) at the 2026 Oscars for Sinners.
Timothée Chalamet was nominated for Best Actor (Leading Role) at the 2026 Oscars for Marty Supreme.
Leonardo DiCaprio was nominated for Best Actor (Leading Role) at the 2026 Oscars for One Battle After Another.
Ethan Hawke was nominated for Best Actor (Leading Role) at the 2026 Oscars for Blue Moon.
Wagner Moura was nominated for Best Actor (Leading Role) at the 2026 Oscars for The Secret Agent.
Michael B. Jordan won Best Actor for his dual performance in Sinners.
Wagner Moura is the first Brazilian actor nominated for Best Actor.
Ethan Hawke is a first-time nominee for Best Actor.
Delroy Lindo is a first-time nominee for Best Actor.
Delroy Lindo is a co-star in Sinners.
Timothée Chalamet won at the Golden Globes.
Timothée Chalamet won at the Critics' Choice Awards.
Michael B. Jordan won the SAG Award.
Jacob Elordi was cited as a nominee for Frankenstein.
Sean Penn was listed in the nominations category alongside Leonardo DiCaprio for One Battle After Another.
Benicio Del Toro was listed in the nominations category alongside Leonardo DiCaprio for One Battle After Another.
Sean Penn and Benicio Del Toro are co-stars of Leonardo DiCaprio in One Battle After Another.
The winners were announced on March 15, 2026.
